title: BrowserOS neo: The Missing Browser for Claude, Cowork & Codex | Product Hunt
excerpt: BrowserOS neo is a web browser built NOT for you but for YOUR AI agents. It runs on your machine and uses your logins, so Claude Code, Cowork, and Codex can finish real tasks on your behalf. Run many agents at once. Replay any session to see what your agents did. Free and open source, 12,000+ GitHub stars.
